text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More countries condemn U.S. aggression against Iraq
- Deputy Prime Minister Aziz says Washington and Tehran are source of threats to security in the Gulf
- Analysts and diplomats in Kuwait say U.S. policy gained more support for Iraq
- Zionist enemy warplanes violate Lebanese airspace
- Iraq and Vietnam sign protocol for economic, commercial and scientific cooperation
- Foreign minister takes part in U.N. General Assembly meetings
- Russia against escalation of tension in Gulf
- American dreams of changing the government in Baghdad disappear following the events in northern Iraq
- Oil minister receives Vietnamese finance minister
- Trade ministry removes more items from the list of banned goods
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
